definitions.explanation: A camera that records images electronically rather than on film. Used for the full category, from compact point-and-shoots to mirrorless and DSLR cameras.

examples.japanese: デジタルカメラを{買|か}い{替|か}えた。
このデジタルカメラは{画質|がしつ}がとても{良|よ}い。
examples.english: This digital camera has very good image quality.

examples.japanese: {旅行|りょこう}のために{軽|かる}くて{高画質|こうがしつ}なデジタルカメラを{探|さが}している。
examples.english: I'm looking for a light, high-quality digital camera for travel.

notes:
Full form of デジカメ. Used in writing, product specifications, and more formal contexts; in conversation, people usually say デジカメ.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- デジタルカメラを{買|か}う: to buy a digital camera
- デジタルカメラの{画質|がしつ}: digital-camera image quality
- {高性能|こうせいのう}のデジタルカメラ: high-performance digital camera

SIMILAR WORDS:
- デジカメ: the casual abbreviation
- フィルムカメラ: film camera — the older alternative
- {一眼|いちがん}カメラ: single-lens (DSLR/mirrorless) camera — a higher-end subcategory
